{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of December 2010 – June 2011. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)|Virtual Block 7.2: Ultimate Freedom]]. The Players Committee released 7.2 on 13 December 2010 and said: "These cards are legal for tournament play starting December 29th."<ref name="j281">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=281:virtual-set-72-released-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Virtual Set 7.2 Released!], Players Committee (13 December 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110115063957/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=281:virtual-set-72-released-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> The PDF has official text as of 15 December 2010.<ref name="pdf72">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Freedom''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 15, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The pool lasted until Virtual Block 7.3, released on 3 June 2011, became legal; that date is unknown.<ref name="j321">[http://starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=321:virtual-set-73-released-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Virtual Set 7.3 Released!], Players Committee (3 June 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110822150351/http://starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=321:virtual-set-73-released-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's name for its constructed format until 2014 was ''Standard'': the 25 July 2014 announcement that replaced this pool was titled "Reset of Standard Format" and said that "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> "Legacy" was created only then, for the pre-reset cards.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–6 and Virtual Block 7.1–7.2
* '''In use:''' 29 December 2010 – June 2011 (until 7.3 became legal; date unknown)
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)|7.2 Ultimate Freedom]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]] (26 cards).<ref name="w-doe">[[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf62">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|6.3 Mercenaries]] (34 cards).<ref name="w-merc">[[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf63">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Mercenaries''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of March 15, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174429/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)|7.1 Ultimate Power]] (48 cards).<ref name="w-up">[[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf71">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Power''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of June 18, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)|7.2 Ultimate Freedom]] (28 cards).<ref name="w-uf">[[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf72" /> Three more Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields" />

Changes made while this pool was in force:

* 26 April 2011: the Competitive Balance Team blanked Medium Transport (V), effective immediately. The post says the change was released at once "and not with the next virtual set (as was announced)".<ref name="j310">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=310:cbt-decision-on-medium-transport-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 CBT decision on Medium Transport (V)], Players Committee (26 April 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110508211508/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=310:cbt-decision-on-medium-transport-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>

== History ==
On 25 October 2010 the Players Committee scheduled 7.2 for 15 December 2010 as a set of about 25–30 cards, "about 75% of which are player-created".<ref name="j279">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=279:virtual-set-72-update-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Virtual Set 7.2 Update], Players Committee (25 October 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110115063802/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=279:virtual-set-72-update-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> Compared with [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]], the pool adds the 28 Ultimate Freedom cards (13 Dark Side, 15 Light Side).<ref name="w-uf" />
